# runbrowser

> Hosted Chromium you drive over CDP with Playwright, Puppeteer, or anything else that speaks it.
> Hosted entirely in the EU. Sessions are billed by the second.

## Getting started

- [Quickstart](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/quickstart.md): Connect an existing Playwright or Puppeteer script in one line, in TypeScript or Python.
- [Concepts](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/concepts.md): Sessions, the session lifecycle, billing granularity, stable sessions, recording, stealth, proxies and the live viewer.
- [Recipes](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/recipes.md): Recipes
- [Autopilot](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-autopilot.md): Describe a task in plain language: what comes back, how to turn it into a pass/fail check, and where it struggles.
- [Checks](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-checks.md): Scheduled browser journeys that heal themselves when a site is rebuilt and report when it actually breaks.
- [Sessions & stable sessions](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-sessions.md): Sessions & stable sessions
- [The live viewer](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-viewer.md): The live viewer
- [Structured extraction](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-extract.md): Structured extraction
- [Crawling a site](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-crawling.md): Crawling a site
- [Screenshots & PDFs](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-capture.md): Screenshots & PDFs
- [Proxies & geo-targeting](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-proxies.md): Proxies & geo-targeting
- [Device profiles](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-device-profile.md): Device profiles
- [Getting through walls](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-unblocking.md): Getting through walls

## Reference

- [API reference](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/api-reference.md): Every endpoint: the CDP WebSocket, sessions, autopilot runs, browser contexts, fetch, search and extract, with request and response shapes.
- [Errors](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/errors.md): Every status code and error code the API returns, with cause, fix, and whether it is worth retrying.
- [SDKs](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-sdk.md): SDKs
- [Integrations](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/guide-integrations.md): Integrations

## Integrations

- [MCP server](https://runbrowser.dev/docs/mcp.md): The hosted MCP server: browser tools for Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients.

## Optional

- [Pricing](https://runbrowser.dev/#pricing): Plan limits and prices.
